html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The Symbiote heroes and Spider-Man have united!

Will they be able to hold back the dark ambition and claim victory?

 

We introduce the November Update, celebrating the addition of the <Symbiote and Spider-Man> Theme.

 

Meet the new Uniforms for Spider-Man, Venom, and Agent Venom, born from the fusion of the perfect host and the symbiote!

 

Agent Venom, the symbiote user brimming with heroism, has received Tier-4 Advancement.

Also, the Venom symbiote’s new spawn, Sleeper, joins the battle with the abilities of Tier-3.

 

Additionally, Odin's Blessing Awakening and Team-up Collection: Symbiote have been added,

so use these to power up your heroes!

 

Various other improvements have been made to make the game more convenient to enjoy,

so please check the details below!

 

▣ One New Hero

 

Check out the abilities of Sleeper <Modern>, confusing enemies with excellent stealth skills.

* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

▣ Three New Uniforms

 

Three new Uniforms have been added in celebration of the Symbiote and Spider-Man Themed Update.

Check out the abilities of Spider-Man <The Symbiote Suit>, Venom <Warstar>, and Agent Venom <Guardians of the Galaxy>.                          

* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats.

(Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)

* The three new Uniforms will be on sale for 50% off during the <November Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

▣ Agent Venom Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added to Agent Venom.

This will further enhance his symbiote power and combat abilities honed during his military days.

* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

▣ Sleeper Tier-3

 

Sleeper, who explored the galaxy to see the wider world, has trained the Tier-3 Ultimate Skill as a means of self-defense.

 

 

 

▣ Molten Man and Hydro-Man

Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Through the November Update, Molten Man and Hydro-Man

will acquire Potential Awakening & Transcendence!

* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ New Growth System - Odin’s Blessing Awakening

 

Agents can obtain the Engraved Odin’s Blessing or Odin’s Glory when awakening the Odin’s Blessing.

Heroes can be granted enhanced stats and Instinct Attack by equipping Awakened Odin’s Blessings!

Use the new material, Eternal Flame, to craft equipment items imbued with Odin’s glory.

 

1. Odin’s Blessing Awakening

- Requires Mythic or higher grade Enchanted Uru, Eternal Flame, and Gold.

* The new material <Eternal Flame> can be acquired from Zombie Survival.

* The success rate may vary depending on the materials used.

(Mythic Enchanted Uru / Odin’s Blessing / Engraved Odin’s Blessing / Odin’s Glory)

* The existing stats are upgraded when Awakening.

* The ‘Odin’s Glory’ will be acquired when Awakening Super Succeeds. Otherwise, the ‘Engraved Odin’s Blessing’ will be acquired.

* The Engraved Odin’s Blessing can be awakened again, but the Odin's Glory cannot.

 

 

 

2. The Awakening Effect Level applies when equipped with the Engraved Odin’s Blessing and Odin’s Glory.

* The awakening effect level is applied to each piece of character gear and is determined by the number of Engraved Odin's Blessing and Odin's Glory equipped.

* Each piece of character gear's Instinct Attack increases by up to +10%.

Therefore, 4 pieces of character gear can increase by up to +40%.

* The awakening effect only applies to heroes equipping Engraved Odin's Blessing and Odin's Glory.

* The same type of Odin's Blessing and Awakened Odin's Blessing cannot be equipped simultaneously with one piece of character gear.

 

 

 

▣ New Team-Up Collection - Symbiote

 

A new Team-Up collection that can enhance the symbiote heroes’ abilities has been added.

Upgrade the target heroes and Uniforms, and acquire various options that will help your battles.

 

 

 

* When the same hero is set under multiple Team-Up Collection themes, the following applies:

- Collection Option: Only the theme option with the highest collection option level will be applied

- Team-Up Option: All Team-Up options apply

 

 

▣ Zombie Survival Improvements

 

1. The Zombie Survival Reward has been improved.

- Eternal Flame has been added to the Ranking reward, Challenges, and Zombie Survival Shop.

- Gold has been added to the Ranking reward.

* The changed rewards will be applied immediately after the 11/19 Update.

The progress of the Zombie Survival Challenge that was completed before the Update will be reset.

* The progress of the Weekly Challenge will remain.

 

 

2. Effects applied to allies and heroes who can apply Passive Skills to the Starting Characters can be checked in the [Select Characters] screen.

 

 

3. The effects have been improved to make it easier to locate the Boss Zombie during battle.

 

4. Improvements have been made and heroes target the Bosses first in Zombie Survival.

- Related texts can be checked in the Zombie Survival loading screen.

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Sleeper, Hydro-Man, and Molten Man have been added.

﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.

- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.

- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.

- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, and one more from the upcoming Event!
 

[September Update New Special Icon]

 


 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms of the Symbiote and Spider-Man theme.

Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn rewards.

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deals

 

 ‘Update Hot Deals’ products have been added.

- Event Schedule:

After the 11/19 Maintenance - 12/10 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),

After the 11/19 Maintenance - 12/10 (Tue) 6:59 (PST)

- ‘2024 Black Friday Tokens’ are included in November Update Hot Deal products.

* 2024 Black Friday Tokens can be used in the Token Shop opening 11/26 (Tue).

* The price is based on the Google Play Store.

 

 

 

 

 

* 6 types of Collection Tokens ranging from Midnight Suns to Symbiote themes can be selected from the Selector: Collection Token.

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. 25 new Daily Trivia questions have been added.

 

2. Tier-4 Advancement Ticket and Mega Advancement Ticket have been added.

- The above items will be sold as an event product in the future.

▶ Tier-4 Advancement Ticket:

Can be used on Tier-3 or Potential Transcended heroes with Lv.80, all Gear +30, Potential Level 12, and Skill Level 10.

▶ Tier-4 Mega Advancement Ticket:

Can be used on Tier-3 or Potential Transcended heroes with Lv.70, all Gear +25, and Potential Max Level 6.

* Native-Level heroes and heroes from certain game modes cannot use the Advancement Ticket.

 

3. The numerical values ​​for certain effects have been improved to display up to the second decimal place.

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The icon being displayed as Tier-3 when watching the Awakened Potential video again

in Team → Uniform has been fixed.

 

2. The HP of heroes being displayed incorrectly in World Boss has been fixed.

 

3. The Challenge count being displayed abnormally in certain conditions has been fixed.

 

4. Unrelated texts being displayed in the Comic Cards Edit Applied Game Mode list have been fixed.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
